2-People.description: 2people is a modular HR suite covering employee data, recruitment, onboarding, time & absence and compliance.

App4sales.description: App4Sales is a B2B e-commerce and ordering platform that lets wholesale customers order through a self-service webshop while sales reps take orders through a companion mobile app.

BRP Systems.description: BRP Systems (Also known as Go Active and Sport Solution) is a platform for managing fitness-facility operations, including memberships, bookings, payments and class scheduling.

Booking Board.description: Booking Board is a gym-management platform that handles bookings, memberships, billing and access control for fitness facilities.

Colect.description: Colect.io is a Danish digital B2B sales and showroom platform for fashion and lifestyle brands, covering line sheets, order writing, digital showrooms and a self-service reorder portal (Brand Portal) for retailers.

danDomain.description: DanDomain is a danish domain registrar and webhosting service.

EasyCruit.description: Visma EasyCruit is a cloud applicant-tracking solution for multi-department, multi-language hiring with automated screening.

Elvium.description: Elvium is a danish recruitment and HR platform with AI-driven candidate screening, onboarding workflows and digital contract management.

Emply.description: Emply is a unified HR platform tying recruitment, onboarding, core HR, feedback and learning into one system.

Flexybox.description: Flexybox is a membership-management and bookings platform tailored for fitness centres and activity venues, covering classes, access control, billing and loyalty.

HR-ON.description: HR-ON is a recruitment, onboarding and day-to-day HR administration system.

Kindly.description: Kindly.ai is a Norwegian conversational-AI platform that equips enterprise-scale e-commerce sites with multilingual chatbots that automate support, recover carts and drive sales.

OpenRecruit.description: OpenRecruit is an applicant tracing system (ATS) focused on “open recruiting” that automates candidate matching, employer branding and integrations

Pondus.description: Pondus is a member-management platform for fitness centres, offering bookings, payments, retention analytics and class scheduling.

Shopify B2B.description: Shopify B2B is Shopify's native wholesale feature set (company accounts, quantity rules, quick order lists) that lets Shopify Plus merchants sell to business customers alongside, or instead of, a regular storefront.

SPY System.description: SPY System (SPY) is a Danish all-in-one ERP and B2B order platform for fashion and lifestyle brands, including a B2B webshop portal hosted for each brand's retailers.

Reqruiting.description: ReQruiting is an all-in-one HR and recruitment system for Danish SMEs with ATS, HR master-data, onboarding and whistle-blower/timesheet tools.

Talentech / HR Manager.description: Talentech is a unified recruitment, onboarding, talent management and HR administration platform.

Traede.description: Traede is a Danish ERP and B2B sales platform for fashion and lifestyle brands, providing order management, a B2B webshop and integrations with Shopify and accounting systems.

Turis.description: Turis is an AI-native B2B ecommerce platform providing a branded, self-serve B2B storefront for brands that sell to retailers.

UserLink.description: UserLink is a customer service chatbot platform that supplies AI-powered live-chat and chatbot agents.

Vimeo.description: Vimeo is a video hosting, sharing and services platform. Vimeo operation an ad-free basis by providing subscription plans.

Weply.description: Weply is a Nordic lead generation chat system designed to enhance lead generation from existing website traffic.

Wondr.description: Wondr is an all-in-one business system for fitness facilities covering bookings, memberships, payments and operations.
